thread:
alex: oncall-bot alert: p99 latency spike in us-west for /v1/generate. p95 from ~80ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~2.8s, success rate stable. noticed around 16:02 UTC. anyone seeing related deploys?

oncall-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency > 2000ms for service=hosted-api env=prod region=us-west metric=p99_latency threshold=2000ms

maria: I rolled the model-variant config 3 hrs ago for A/B. checking rollout now. if it's traffic-distribution change, immediate rollback makes sense.

sam: I see a queue backlog on pods serving gpt-small-quant. KV cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 60%. possibly cache eviction due to seq-length surge.

kevin: can we apply a fast circuit-breaker to heavy routes and route 20% to fallback smaller model in us-west? that should drop p99 quickly.

alex: +1 to fallback. also let's throttle bursty API keys that are spiking suffix=corp-analytics. run quick query and list top 10 keys by req/s last 5m.

maria: starting rollback of variant config now -> `kubectl -n hosted apply -f rollout-revert.yaml`

sam: enabling routing rule: 
```
route: /v1/generate
filters:
  - type: fallback
    when: p99>1000ms
    to_model: gpt-small-quant
    split: 0.2
```
Applying on routing tier.

kevin: throttling token buckets for corp-analytics key: `redwood-cli rate-limit set --key corp-analytics --rps 5`

alex: running repro: I hit endpoint with a seq length 2k payload and saw KV misses - reproduces in staging. looks like recent prompt templates include long system context.

maria: rollback finished, propagation ~30s. early metrics show p95 dropping back toward 120ms. p99 still ~900ms.

sam: fallback rules active. starting gradual increase of split from 20%->40% if p99 > 800ms after 2m.

oncall-bot: [INFO] rollout-revert completed by maria at 16:07 UTC.

kevin: added emergency circuit breaker config to proxy: max_concurrent_per_key=8, queue_depth=64 for /v1/generate. this should limit head-of-line stalls.

alex: customer tickets (T-3421, T-3422) notified, updated with mitigation steps. asking support to inform customers of degraded latency and that we are rolling mitigations.

maria: observed cause summary: combination of longer seq lengths + config rollout changed model sizing for a subset of traffic -> cache pressure + higher exec time -> p99 amplification.

sam: followup actions: 1) restore cache sizing default, 2) add threshold-based automated fallback (p95>500ms), 3) add per-key burst limits and clearer docs on recommended seq-lengths.

kevin: created short-term SLO guardrail PR: `slo-guardrails: add circuit-breaker + rate-limit defaults` will enforce conservative defaults for new secrets.

alex: can we add region fallback if us-west p99 stays >1000ms for >5m? route small fraction to us-east automatically.

maria: yes added a rule to routing plane: if region.p99>1000ms for 300s -> split 10% to us-east. applied.

oncall-bot: [ACTION] automated fallback to us-east scheduled if threshold persists.

sam: monitoring: adding dashboard panels for KV cache hit rate, seq-length distribution, and top keys by p95 contribution.

kevin: will follow up with permanent fixes: model sizing rollback, autoscaler tuning, and adding quota enforcement on large batch requests.

alex: thank you team — current status: p95 ~140ms, p99 ~420ms and trending down. keeping routing fallback active until metrics stable for 15m. created postmortem ticket PM-558.

maria: assigning postmortem owners and adding timeline + mitigation notes.

sam: tl;dr playbook we used: detect->isolate (throttle keys + cb)->fallback (smaller model + region)->rollback config->monitor->postmortem. saving to runbook. :white_check_mark:

kevin: reopening to add a short reproducible snippet to the postmortem: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"prompt":"<long system context ...>"}'` with ~2k tokens.

alex: closing channel if nothing else. will leave runbook link in PM-558. thanks everyone :heart:
